newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Congress Black Caucus blasts Fed rate hike.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Congress Black Caucus blasts Fed rate hike.

text.p: The Congressional Black Caucus scheduled a news conference Thursday to criticize Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan for raising interest rates.
The caucus, made up of the 39 black Democrats in Congress, called the interest rate hikes "unjustified, destructive and wrong" in a statement Wednesday.

"During the press conference, CBC members will question Fed Chairman Alan Greenspan's logic and economic assumptions which led to the interest rate hike," the statement said. The news conference is scheduled for 0930 edt at the U.S. Capitol.
